delayed_gcode _dry_filament_done.gcode:
M140 S0
_RESTORE_IDLE_TIMEOUT
RESPOND MSG="Filament drying finished"

gcode_macro _ensure_homed.description: Helper: home all axes if not homed

gcode_macro _extrude.description: Helper: relative extrude (negative = retract) only if the nozzle is hot. LENGTH= SPEED=mm/s

gcode_macro _filament_move.description: Helper: relative extruder move with save/restore. E= SPEED=mm/s
gcode_macro _filament_move.gcode:
SAVE_GCODE_STATE NAME=_fmove
M83
G1 E{params.E|float} F{params.SPEED|default(5)|float * 60}
RESTORE_GCODE_STATE NAME=_fmove

gcode_macro _goto_tower.description: Helper: lift to tower_z, then move over the purge tower

gcode_macro _heat_for_filament.description: Helper: heat for filament moves (paused: the print's temp; else current target or filament_temp)

gcode_macro _park.description: Helper: lift by LIFT (at least to Z_MIN, never past Z max), then move to X/Y unless XY=0

gcode_macro _printer_settings.description: Tunable values used by the macros in this file

gcode_macro _purge_line.description: Helper: prime line along the front edge
gcode_macro _purge_line.gcode:
{% set s = printer['gcode_macro _PRINTER_SETTINGS'] %}
SAVE_GCODE_STATE NAME=_purge
G90
M83
G1 X70 Y-2 Z0.6 F2400
G1 E{s.purge_prime} F600
G1 X130 E{s.purge_length} F900
G1 X140 F3000
G1 Z1 F600
G92 E0
RESTORE_GCODE_STATE NAME=_purge

gcode_macro _restore_idle_timeout.description: Helper: put idle_timeout back to the printer.cfg value

gcode_macro _wipe.description: Helper: wipe the hot nozzle on the rear wiper and lift (needs homed axes)

gcode_macro cancel_print.description: Cancel: retract, heaters/fan off, park, clear pause state

gcode_macro clean_nozzle.description: Heat, wipe on the rear wiper, cool down and re-home. CLEAN_NOZZLE [TEMP=220]

gcode_macro dry_filament.description: Hold the bed hot to dry filament. DRY_FILAMENT [TEMP=60] [HOURS=3]

gcode_macro load_filament.description: Load. Idle: purge over the X0 tower then wipe. Paused: load at the park spot. [TEMP=] [LENGTH=] [PURGE=]

gcode_macro m600.description: Filament change: park high, (optionally unload), wait for RESUME

gcode_macro mesh_calibrate.description: Heat bed, home, probe a full bed mesh and save it. MESH_CALIBRATE [BED_TEMP=60]

gcode_macro park.gcode:
{% set s = printer['gcode_macro _PRINTER_SETTINGS'] %}
_PARK X={params.X|default(s.park_x)} Y={params.Y|default(s.park_y)} LIFT={params.LIFT|default(s.park_lift)} Z_MIN={params.Z_MIN|default(0)}

gcode_macro pause.description: Pause: retract, lift and park. PAUSE [X=] [Y=] [Z_MIN=] [PARK=0 lifts only] [REASON=]

gcode_macro pid_bed.description: PID tune the bed. PID_BED [TEMP=60]  (then SAVE_CONFIG)
gcode_macro pid_bed.gcode:
PID_CALIBRATE HEATER=heater_bed TARGET={params.TEMP|default(60)}
RESPOND MSG="Run SAVE_CONFIG to keep the new values"

gcode_macro pid_hotend.description: PID tune the hotend. PID_HOTEND [TEMP=220]  (then SAVE_CONFIG)
gcode_macro pid_hotend.gcode:
M106 S255
PID_CALIBRATE HEATER=extruder TARGET={params.TEMP|default(220)}
M106 S0
RESPOND MSG="Run SAVE_CONFIG to keep the new values"

gcode_macro print_end.description: Slicer end: retract, present the print, heaters/motors off
gcode_macro print_end.gcode:
{% set s = printer['gcode_macro _PRINTER_SETTINGS'] %}
_EXTRUDE LENGTH=-{s.end_retract} SPEED={s.retract_speed}
TURN_OFF_HEATERS
M106 S0
_PARK X={s.end_park_x} Y={s.end_park_y} LIFT={s.end_lift}
M400
BED_MESH_CLEAR
SET_PAUSE_NEXT_LAYER ENABLE=0
SET_PAUSE_AT_LAYER ENABLE=0 LAYER=0
_RESTORE_IDLE_TIMEOUT
M84
RESPOND MSG="Print finished"

gcode_macro purge_filament.description: Purge. Idle: over the X0 tower then wipe. Paused: at the park spot. [LENGTH=20] [TEMP=]

gcode_macro resume.description: Resume: reheat if needed, prime and return. RESUME [KEEP_OFFSETS=1] [VELOCITY=]

gcode_macro set_pause_at_layer.description: Enable/disable a pause if a given layer number is reached

gcode_macro set_pause_next_layer.description: Enable a pause if the next layer is reached

gcode_macro set_print_stats_info.description: Overwrite, to get pause_next_layer and pause_at_layer feature

gcode_macro stop_drying.gcode:
UPDATE_DELAYED_GCODE ID=_DRY_FILAMENT_DONE DURATION=0
M140 S0
_RESTORE_IDLE_TIMEOUT
RESPOND MSG="Drying stopped"

gcode_macro unload_filament.description: Unload. Idle: over the X0 tower. Paused: in place at the park spot. [TEMP=] [LENGTH=]
